name: tt-metrics-exporter
description: A Kubernetes metrics exporter for Tenstorrent Wormhole and Blackhole clusters, written in Python. Runs as a node-local DaemonSet, reads telemetry through sysfs and the tt-kmd device paths, and optionally reports DRA state. Includes a QEMU ttsim VM setup for testing without hardware.
author: Varrahan Uthayan
